3.text: Nimunyihanganire kugira ngo nanjye mvuge,Nimara kuvuga mukomeze museke.

4.text: Mbese umuntu ni we ntakira?Icyatuma ntareka kwihangana ni iki?

6.text: Iyo niyibutse ngira ubwoba,Kandi umushyitsi ugatigisa umubiri wanjye.

7.text: (7-8) “Ni iki gituma abanyabyaha babaho,Bakisāzira ndetse bakarushaho gukomera?Urubyaro rwabo rukomerana na bo barureba,N'ababakomokaho na bo bakabakomerera imbere.

8.text: Ingo zabo zibamo amahoro ntizigire icyo zīkanga,Kandi inkoni y'Imana ntibabanguriwe.

9.text: Amapfizi yabo arabyara ntabwo acogora,N'inka zabo zihora zibyara ntabwo ziramburura.

10.text: Abana babo bato babagenda imbere nk'umukumbi,Kandi abana babo barabyina.

12.text: Iminsi yabo bayimara baguwe neza,Hanyuma bakamanukira ikuzimu badatinze.

13.text: Bakabwira Imana kandi bati‘Tuveho kuko tudashaka kumenya inzira zawe.’

14.text: Bati ‘Ishoborabyose ni iki kugira ngo tuyikorere?Kandi nituyisenga bizatumarira iki?’

15.text: Dore ihirwe ryabo ntiriri mu maboko yabo,Inama y'inkozi z'ibibi imbe kure.

16.text: “Ni kangahe itabaza ry'abanyabyaha rijya rizima,Ibyago byabo bikabageraho,Imana ikabagororera imibabaro,Ibitewe n'uburakari bwayo,

17.text: Kugira ngo bamere nk'ibishakashaka bigurukanwa n'umuyaga,Nk'umurama utumurwa n'ishuheri?

18.text: “Muravuga muti‘Imana ibikira abana b'umunyabyaha igihano cy'ibyaha bye.’Ahubwo umunyabyaha ubwe abe ari we ihana,Kugira ngo abimenye.

19.text: Amaso ye abe ari yo areba kurimbuka kwe,Kandi anywe uburakari bw'Ishoborabyose.

20.text: Mbese ibizaba ku b'inzu ye bamukurikiye azabyitaho,Kandi apfuye akenyutse?

21.text: Hari uzigisha Imana ubwenge,Kandi ari yo icira urubanza abakomeye?

22.text: “Umwe apfa agifite imbaraga zishyitse,Aguwe neza rwose kandi afite amahoro

23.text: Ibicuba bye byuzuye amata,Kandi umusokoro wo mu magufwa ye urayagirana.

24.text: Undi apfa afite intimba mu mutima,Atigeze kubona ibyiza.

26.text: “Dore nzi ibyo mutekereza,N'imigambi mujya yo kungirira nabi.

27.text: Kuko muvuga muti ‘Inzu y'igikomangoma iri he?N'urugo abanyabyaha babagamo ruri he?’

29.text: Yuko umunyabyaha abikiwe umunsi w'amakuba,Kandi ko bajyanywe mu munsi w'uburakari?

30.text: Ni nde wamugaragariza inzira ye bahanganye?Ni nde wamwitura ibyo yakoze?

31.text: Nyamara azajyanwa mu mva,Kandi abantu bazarinda igituro cye.

32.text: Ibisinde byo mu gikombe bizamuryohera,Kandi abantu bose bazamukurikira,Nk'abamubanjirije batabarika.

33.text: “Noneho ni iki gituma mumporesha iby'ubusa?Ko numva ibyo munsubiza ari ibinyoma bisa!”
